description: This file defines the implementation of absl::node_hash_map, an unordered associative container optimized for speed and memory efficiency, including class templates, member functions, and internal policies.

classes.name: absl::node_hash_map
classes.description: A hash map container class template supporting heterogeneous lookup, capacity management, and various insertion and deletion operations, designed as a more efficient alternative to std::unordered_map.

methods.name: node_hash_map
methods.description: Default constructor for the node_hash_map class template.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the container.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the beginning of the container.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the end of the container.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the container.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the number of element slots (including open, deleted, and empty) within the hash map.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the hash map is empty.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the container can hold.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the hash map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the hash map, invalidating references and iterators.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Erases elements by iterator, range, or key.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts elements into the hash map, with various overloads for different input types.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Inserts or assigns an element with a given key.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element in-place.

methods.name: emplace_hint
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element at a hint position.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element only if the key does not already exist.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts elements as node handles.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges elements from another hash map.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another hash map.

methods.name: rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the container to a specified number of slots.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses element by key with bounds checking.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash map.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements with a specific key (0 or 1).

methods.name: equal_range
methods.description: Returns the range of elements matching a key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an element by key.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts an element by key.

methods.name: bucket_count
methods.description: Returns the number of buckets.

methods.name: load_factor
methods.description: Returns the current load factor.

methods.name: max_load_factor
methods.description: Gets or sets the maximum load factor.

methods.name: get_allocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator used by the container.

methods.name: hash_function
methods.description: Returns the hash function used.

methods.name: key_eq
methods.description: Returns the key equality predicate.
